Title: Introduction to Patreon and Supporters
Summary: The video opens with a black screen displaying the Patreon logo and a list of supporters' names. The Pi character appears in the center, and the background transitions to a light orange color, showcasing the Patreon website with the text 'Partner to Win' and 'The early stage.' The screen transitions to a black background with the text 'Chicky stuff' at the top. The Pi character is now light blue, and its eyes blink twice. The Pi character continues to blink its eyes while the text 'Chicky stuff' remains at the top of the screen. The Pi character's expression changes, and it appears to be explaining something related to 'chicky stuff.'
